reading: Time on high flow is driven less by the infant than by the weaning habit of the attending on duty. Retrieved evidence supports direct cessation for most infants, but the question that worries the PICU team, safety in infants under 8 weeks, is exactly where the evidence conflicts (claim c3). The night is the weak link: checks are done by nurses alone and are often missed elsewhere (claim c4), which could both delay trials off and delay spotting re-escalation.

nodes.label: Direct-cessation weaning protocol
nodes.detail: Trial off after two stable hours in FiO2 40 percent or less.

nodes.label: Conflict on infants under 8 weeks
nodes.detail: Doubled re-escalation in one study, none in an undated preprint (claim c3).

summary: Map links the protocol to time on high flow and safety, with the young-infant conflict and night checks marked.
